name: C11 STFT/ISTFT parity vs wubuwizard scipy recipe (torch convention)
bar: STFT max|diff| <= 1e-4 vs torch/scipy (scope bar 1); ISTFT max|diff| <= 1e-4

results.stft_bins0_2_note: recipe zeroes bins 0-2 post-STFT; my raw bins 0-2 peak at 1.99 (matches scipy fresh-STFT vs saved-spek gap of 1.99)

references.istft_ref: istft_ref_f32.bin [2,261120] (scipy istft_complex of ORT final_output, TRIM-cut)

implementation.stft: sep_stft.c + sep_fft64.c: reflect-pad, periodic Hann, complex-out; FFT in DOUBLE precision (2048x3 Cooley-Tukey, table-driven twiddles)
implementation.istft: sep_stft.c + sep_fft.c: OLA + squared-window envelope division (scipy convention), float32
implementation.why_double: float32 2048x3 FFT error 1.67e-04 on this spectrum (peaked audio: recombination cancels large terms to small bins); numpy/torch complex64 achieve 4-6e-06. Double FFT puts my STFT at torch's own error (1.53e-05). FFT is not the bottleneck (~0.3 s/chunk for STFT+ISTFT pair, 2 threads).
bugs_found_and_fixed: fft3_64 transcription typo: im[1]/im[2] last term used x2i instead of x2r (real planes perfect, imaginary planes in k2=1,2 garbage up to 38). Caught by standalone fft3_64(1,2,3) unit check vs hand-computed values.
Makefile: test_stft prerequisites omitted sep_fft.c/sep_fft64.c, so make did not rebuild after the fft3 fix (stale binary re-tested at 38.06). Fixed: .c files now listed as prerequisites.
implementation.traps_confirmed: n_fft=6144 is NOT a power of two (wubu_fft radix-2 cannot do it) — mixed-radix 2048x3 written from scratch; wubu_fft sign convention verified empirically (forward=inv=1 then xN; inverse=inv=0 then /N); reflect padding matches torch exactly (zero-pad would disagree by 22.3 on edges per wubuwizard)

timing: STFT+ISTFT for one chunk ~0.3 s wall (2 threads, includes file IO)
